newsitem.title: USA: Reuters 30-day muni supply falls to $6.192 bln.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 30-day muni supply falls to $6.192 bln.

text.p: Reuters said Tuesday it calculated its 30-day visible supply of upcoming municipal bond sales at $6.192 billion, down $232 million from Monday.

Negotiated sales total $4.214 billion in 64 issues and competitive bond sales total $1.977 billion in 121 issues. Reuters visible supply counts all deals underwriters have either scheduled for sale in the next 30 business days, or have said they tentatively plan to price during the period.

The supply figure is based on sales data compiled by Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group and uses municipal securities with maturities 13 months or longer. All bond deals $1 million or larger are included.
